vars.prTitle: Log identity provider creation at debug level
vars.prBody: Add a debug log when an identity provider is created through the admin API, including alias, providerId and the (secret-stripped) config. Helps troubleshooting misconfigured brokers without exposing the client secret in the logs.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "The new debug statement calls StripSecretsUtils.stripSecrets(session, representation) on the incoming request representation before RepresentationToModel.toModel(...) runs. stripSecrets does not return a sanitized copy: it mutates the passed object in place (REPRESENTATION_FORMATTER -> stripBroker -> stripFromMap(rep.getConfig(), \"clientSecret\") replaces the value with ComponentRepresentation.SECRET_VALUE '**********') and returns the same instance. The arguments are evaluated even when debug is off, so every IdP created via POST /identity-provider/instances is persisted with clientSecret='**********' (RepresentationToModel.toModel copies representation.getConfig() into the model), breaking the broker's token exchange. The existing call in create() is safe only because it runs after the model has been persisted.", "severity": "High"}]
